name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.183.0 — A note is a conversation: turnOf(n) in lib/mocks-notes.js is the one derivation of whose turn it is (session/you/done/dropped) off status/resolution/addressed/reply, replacing four separate per-surface colour rules; the owner may reply on the page as often as they like (POST /__notes/reopen now refuses only a resolved note), the CLI's now-redundant reply subcommand and its writer are deleted in favor of one session verb (notes address), and POST /__notes/resolve requires an explicit verdict so Approve and Reject write different records — Reject is final and hidden from every page. notes open now lists only what waits on the session. ADR-0025 narrows specs/20260912/12 D17, specs/20260902/10 D4 and specs/20260912/06's row controls. 7.182.0 — Silence is not a pass (specs/20260913/08): a release leg that measured nothing — ci with no adapter or an unseen sha, ci still in progress, a declined production promotion, a substrate manifest of only inert rows — now derives UNVERIFIED on the release profile via one shared derivation (lib/release-unmeasured.js); release-legs.js stage prints a ⚪ glyph and an UNMEASURED: line and exits 1 so /spec:release stops before promotion. Genesis now makes brief 01 the first-light brief: genesis-driver refuses roadmap-written until brief 01 names its First light: record. 7.181.0 — The critic is out: the mocks chain now derives THEME straight off a fully approved WIREFRAMES stage, retiring the fresh-context critic pass and its ledger-pinned question producer end to end — the retired mark, reopen target, ask subcommand and answer route are all refused as unknown inputs now, the critic agent and its two dispatch sites are gone, and an assumption row is confirmed or overridden only by the human-run `ledger set`. A note a person did not type stays on disk but is never listed, grouped, counted or gated on again, and the composer's reason chips are retired in the same stroke — the textarea grows to fill the freed height.
